key_insight: TRACE is an energy-conserving interatomic potential that pairs ACE density correlations with local multihead cross-attention to model complex many-body chemistry efficiently.
engineering_relevance: It offers a unified, scalable route to simulate phase behavior, liquids, and reaction barriers on modest hardware without passing learned states between atoms.
method: Builds an O(3)-equivariant center state from atomic cluster expansion density correlations
Uses local multihead cross-attention to query fixed tensorial neighbor features based on species and geometry
Trains a single architecture for polymorph energetics, liquid structure, and reaction free energies
evidence_signal: The abstract reports successful validation on cesium lead iodide, liquid water, and methyl migration, including near-experimental phase-crossing and free-energy estimates.
watch_item: Performance may depend on carefully chosen training configurations and enhanced/umbrella sampling for rare-event transitions, so transfer to new chemistries still needs validation.
